description.defense-of-the-craft.tango: Forage to survive on the battlefield.
active.defense-of-the-craft.tango: Consumes the target tree leaves to gain health regeneration for some time. The tree leaves are destroyed in the process.
description.defense-of-the-craft.enchant: The bittersweet flavors of Jidi Isle are irresistible to amphibians.
active.defense-of-the-craft.enchanted_ma: Consumes the mango and instantly restores 40 mana.
description.defense-of-the-craft.dust_of: One may hide visage, but never volume.
active.defense-of-the-craft.dust_of_appe: Creates a 12x12x12 area centered around the wielder that reveals invisible units.
description.defense-of-the-craft.gem_of_: Not one thrall creature of the depths, nor spirit bound in drowning's keep, nor Maelrawn the Tentacular, shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.gem_of_true: Reveals nearby invisible enemies in 8x8x8 area, rendering them visible.
description.defense-of-the-craft.radiant: Small pieces of bluish glowing material. What could they be used for?
description.defense-of-the-craft.dire_cr: Small pieces of reddish glowing material. What could they be used for?
description.defense-of-the-craft.radiant: Mineral known for its unpredictable structure. It is a bluish, glowing substance blessed with benevolent magic.
description.defense-of-the-craft.dire_cr: Mineral known for its unpredictable evil structure. It is a reddish, glowing substance blessed with unkind magic.
description.defense-of-the-craft.radiant: Magic dust with a little blue glow around it.
description.defense-of-the-craft.dire_cr: Magic dust with a little red glow around it.
description.defense-of-the-craft.mithril: Four times stronger than iron, yet much lighter. It has high malleability but it requires very high temperatures to be worked.
description.defense-of-the-craft.magic_s: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.
active.defense-of-the-craft.magic_stick: Uses up all charges to instantly heal and replenish the caster's health and mana based on the number of charges.
description.defense-of-the-craft.magic_w: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.
active.defense-of-the-craft.magic_wand: Uses up all charges to instantly heal and replenish the caster's health and mana based on the number of charges.
description.defense-of-the-craft.hand_of: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner's pockets.
active.defense-of-the-craft.hand_of_mida: Instantly kills the target entity, transmuting it into random valuable resources. The transmutation can generate coal, iron ingot, gold ingot, diamond, and a netherite ingot.
description.defense-of-the-craft.shadow_: A small talisman that clouds the senses of one's enemies when held perfectly still.
active.defense-of-the-craft.shadow_amule: Turns the wielder invisible. The invisibility is broken upon using item, or upon attacking.
description.defense-of-the-craft.blink_d: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.
active.defense-of-the-craft.blink_dagger: Instantly teleports the wielder towards the targeted point. Taking any damage resets the cooldown of this item to 3 seconds.
description.defense-of-the-craft.blight_: An unnerving stone unearthed beneath the Fields of Endless Carnage.
description.defense-of-the-craft.gloves_: A pair of magical gloves that seems to render weapons weightless.
description.defense-of-the-craft.sages_m: A mask commonly used by mages and warlocks for various rituals.
description.defense-of-the-craft.blades_: The damage of these small, concealable blades should not be underestimated.
description.defense-of-the-craft.mithril: A hammer forged of pure mithril.
description.defense-of-the-craft.broadsw: The classic weapon of choice for knights, this blade is sturdy and reliable for slaying enemies.
description.defense-of-the-craft.claymor: A sword that can cut through armor, it's a commonly chosen first weapon for budding swordsmen.
description.defense-of-the-craft.oblivio: Deceptively hidden as an ordinary quarterstaff, it is actually very powerful, much like the Eldritch who originally possessed it.
description.defense-of-the-craft.javelin: A rather typical spear that can sometimes pierce through an enemy's armor when used to attack.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.javelin: Grants the wielder's attack a 25% chance to pierce through evasion and deal bonus magical damage.
description.defense-of-the-craft.blade_o: A long blade imbued with time magic.
description.defense-of-the-craft.ogre_ax: You grow stronger just by holding it.
description.defense-of-the-craft.staff_o: A staff of magical powers passed down from the eldest mages.
description.defense-of-the-craft.belt_of: A valued accessory for improving vitality.
description.defense-of-the-craft.band_of: A tensile fabric often used for its light weight and ease of movement.
description.defense-of-the-craft.robe_of: This robe corrupts the soul of the user, but provides wisdom in return.
description.defense-of-the-craft.void_st: Jewelry that was once used to channel nether realm magic, this ring pulses with energy.
description.defense-of-the-craft.ring_of: A shiny ring found beneath a fat halfling’s corpse.
description.defense-of-the-craft.sacred_: An ancient weapon that often turns the tides of war.
description.defense-of-the-craft.talisma: A necklace that allows you to anticipate enemy attacks.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.talisman_of: Grants the wielder a 10% chance to evade any hostile mob or player attack.
description.defense-of-the-craft.eagleso: Capturing the majestic call of an eagle, this mystical horn brings limitless dexterity to those who hear it.
description.defense-of-the-craft.mystic_: Enigmatic staff made of only the most expensive crystals.
description.defense-of-the-craft.reaver: A massive axe capable of tearing whole mountains down.
description.defense-of-the-craft.demon_e: One of the oldest weapons forged by the Demon-Smith Abzidian, it killed its maker when he tested its edge.
description.defense-of-the-craft.ring_of: An ageless ring forged with an otherwise simple blood magic amplified by the presumed source of its key component.
description.defense-of-the-craft.energy_: This lapis gemstone is commonly added to the collection of wizards seeking to improve their presence in combat.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.energy_boos: Grants the wielder 50 maximum mana bonus.
description.defense-of-the-craft.vitalit: A ruby gemstone that has been passed down through generations of warrior kin.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.vitality_bo: Grants the wielder 4 maximum health bonus.
description.defense-of-the-craft.orchid_: A garnet rod constructed from the essence of a fire demon.
active.defense-of-the-craft.orchid_malev: Silences a target entity for 5 seconds. Cooldowns 20 seconds
description.defense-of-the-craft.bloodth: A reviled blade that bites deeper with each wriggle of its victim's final throes.
active.defense-of-the-craft.bloodthorn: Silences a target entity for 5 seconds. When the target is attacked, they get 3 bonus magical damage. Cooldowns 20 seconds.
description.defense-of-the-craft.rod_of_: Atos, the Lord of Blight, has his essence stored in this deceptively simple wand.
active.defense-of-the-craft.rod_of_atos: Roots a targeted entity in place, preventing it from mooving. Cooldowns 20 seconds.
description.defense-of-the-craft.heart_o: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer's fortitude.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.heart_of_ta: Grants the wielder 20% health regeneration amplification.
description.defense-of-the-craft.aeon_di: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the Ivory Incubarium. Or so many believe.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.aeon_disk: Grants the wielder 50 maximum mana bonus and 4 maximum health bonus. When the wielder takes 30% of their maximum health or more damage from a player, applies a strong dispel and a buff on the wielder, that negates all damage the wielder takes, but also negates any damage they deal while active. Cooldowns 180 seconds.
description.defense-of-the-craft.monkey_: A powerful staff used by a master warrior.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.monkey_king: Grants the wielder's attack a 50% chance to pierce through evasion and deal bonus magical damage.
description.defense-of-the-craft.crystal: A blade forged from rare crystals, it seeks weak points in enemy armor.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.crystalys: The wielder's attacks have a 20% chance to inflict bonus 125% critical damage.
description.defense-of-the-craft.daedalu: A weapon of incredible power that is difficult for even the strongest of warriors to control.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.daedalus: The wielder's attacks have a 20% chance to inflict bonus 150% critical damage.
description.defense-of-the-craft.butterf: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.butterfly: Grants the wielder a 20% chance to evade any hostile mob or player attack.
description.defense-of-the-craft.divine_: So powerful, it cannot have a single owner.
description.defense-of-the-craft.diffusa: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.diffusal_bl: The wielder's attacks burn 20 of their target's mana and deal damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
active.defense-of-the-craft.diffusal_bla: Greatly slows the target enemy's movement speed, which decays over the duration.
description.defense-of-the-craft.desolat: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.desolator: The wielder's successful attack applies 4 armor reduction debuff on the affected enemy unit.
description.defense-of-the-craft.skull_b: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul's ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.skull_bashe: Grants the wielder's attacks a 25% chance to stun the target and deal bonus physical damage.
description.defense-of-the-craft.abyssal: The lost blade of the Commander of the Abyss, this edge cuts into an enemy's soul.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.abyssal_bla: Grants the wielder's attacks a 25% chance to stun the target and deal bonus physical damage.
active.defense-of-the-craft.abyssal_blad: Instantly stuns the target enemy unit and teleports the wielder to it. Pierces debuff immunity.
description.defense-of-the-craft.shadow_: The blade of a fallen king, it allows you to move unseen and strike from the shadows.
active.defense-of-the-craft.shadow_blade: The wielder becomes invisible for 15 seconds and gains a movement speed bonus. When the wielder hits an enemy from invisibility, they deal 4 bonus damage.
description.defense-of-the-craft.silver_: Once used to slay an unjust king, only to have the kingdom erupt into civil war in the aftermath.
active.defense-of-the-craft.silver_edge: The wielder becomes invisible for 15 seconds and gains a movement speed bonus. When the wielder hits an enemy from invisibility, they deal 4 bonus damage and apply break effect.
description.defense-of-the-craft.radianc: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.radiance: Grants the wielder a passive 10% chance to evade an enemy attack. When active, scorches enemies in 8x8x8 area, dealing 2 magical damage over time. Enemies are determined by the current item mode.
active.defense-of-the-craft.radiance: Changes the item mode between disabled, PvE, and PvP.
description.defense-of-the-craft.sange: Sange is an unusually accurate weapon, seeking weak points automatically.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.sange: Grants the wielder a 12% health restore amplification.
description.defense-of-the-craft.yasha: Yasha is regarded as the swiftest weapon ever created.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.yasha: Grants the wielder a 12.5% movement speed boost.
description.defense-of-the-craft.kaya: The staff of a renowned sorceress, lost for countless millennia.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.kaya: Grants the wielder a 10% mana cost reduction bonus.
description.defense-of-the-craft.echo_sa: A deceptively swift blade imbued with resonant magic.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.echo_sabre: The next attack grants the wielder a buff that greatly increases attack speed for one attack. Grants the wielder 1.75 mana regeneration.
description.defense-of-the-craft.heavens: This halberd moves with the speed of a smaller weapon, allowing the bearer to win duels that a heavy edge would not.
passive.defense-of-the-craft.heavens_hal: Grants the wielder a 15% chance to evade any hostile mob or player attack.
active.defense-of-the-craft.heavens_halb: Disarms the targeted enemy unit for 3 seconds, preventing them from attacking.
description.defense-of-the-craft.swift_b: A cunning blade able to anticipate and enable its bearer's movements.
active.defense-of-the-craft.swift_blink: Instantly teleports the wielder towards the targeted point. After teleport the wielder's attack and movement speed are increased. Taking any damage resets the cooldown of this item to 3 seconds.
description.defense-of-the-craft.arcane_: A revitalizing tool to help bear the weight of arcane expenditure.
active.defense-of-the-craft.arcane_blink: Instantly teleports the wielder towards the targeted point. After teleport the wielder's health and mana are restored. Taking any damage resets the cooldown of this item to 3 seconds.
description.defense-of-the-craft.overwhe: A horrifying dagger forged in the chaos maw and nigh untouchable by mortal hands.
active.defense-of-the-craft.overwhelming: Instantly teleports the wielder towards the targeted point. After teleport a huge shockwave is created at the target location, dealing 5% of wielder's strength as damage to all nearby creatures and slowing them down. Taking any damage resets the cooldown of this item to 3 seconds.
